Fit,Ⓒa.Ⓓyogya, kzama, nyAyya, anurUpa, upapanna, yukta, ucita, yaTArha, samucita, yaTAyogya, saM-gata; oft. by arh or pot. pass. part.; ‘to be f(it) for’ kxp 1 A (with dat.), yuj-upapad pass. arh 1 P, ucita-yogya- a. BU; ‘f(it) to do a work’ karmakzama, alaMkarmIRa.
Ⓔv. t.Ⓓyuj 7 U, 10, samA-saM-DA 3 U, yogya-yukta a. kf 8 U; ‘f(it) an arrow’ bARaM saM-DA; See Fix; ‘this ill-f(it)s thee’ nEta-danurUpaM BavataH; ‘f(it) out’ sajjIkf, sannah c., upakaraREH upakxp c., or saMyuj or upaskf; ‘fit up’ Decorate, q. v.
Ⓔv. i.Ⓓyuj-upa-pad pass., Sliz pass., yukta a. BU; ‘this f(it)s well’ suSlizwametat (Mal. 1), susaMgata-midaM.
Ⓔs.ⒹAkramaH, AveSaH, avatAraH, aBi-BavaH, ‘f(it) of anger’ kopAveSaH; ‘f(it) of fever’ jvarAkramaH, jvarABiBavaH.
Ⓑ
 2 mUrCA, Brami f., BrAmaraM.

Ⓝ[Fitful]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹyuktaM, u-citaM, samyak, yaTArhaM, sAMprataM, sTAne.
Ⓝ[Fit]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹyuktatA, yogyatA, kzamatA, pAtratA, upayo-gitA, upapatti f., saMgati f., paryApti f., yA-TArTyaM, deSarUpaM.
